title: Fourier coefficient and signed dictator distance
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and choose whether to negate its dictator. The quantity one minus twice the fraction of inputs on which $f$ differs from that signed dictator is at most the absolute value of the singleton Fourier coefficient of $f$ at coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: the negation choice is a Boolean value
